snippet.title: Dance of Theseus | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Dance of Theseus is a dress-up life sim set in the glamorous world of monster ballrooms. Craft new body parts, assemble yourself, and outshine everyone at themed events. Fit in. Stand out. Make friends. Fall in love. How many parts will you replace before finding your way back home?

Wishlist Dance of Theseus now on Steam: (https://s.team/a/3581260)
Join Our Discord: (https://discord.gg/SCVFr2nNaj)

Game Developed by: Citreat Studio
Trailer Music & SFX by: KALA & Dana Kendell
Trailer Voice Acting by:
Girl - Elissa Park
Winks - Alexander Hanly
Thea - Julia Nero
